feeds.title: BOOMER Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Boomer Magazine entertains informs and engages readers with captivating interviews, regional features, informative articles and contributions from Richmond's favorite writers. Check out the magazine and read more about the music in Virginia.

feeds.title: Richmond Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Richmond Magazine is a locally-owned publication that covers the Richmond, Virginia region. The magazine has been published for more than 40 years and also publishes R•Home and Richmond Bride. Richmond magazine covers topics such as Dining, Entertainment, Shopping, Health care, Travel, Political and personal issues. In this section, you can read everything about music.

feeds.title: Letter V Blog
feeds.description: Letter V: the Virginia Classical Music Blog, produced by Clarke Bustard, features news, concert reviews and commentary on music and the arts, as well as the most comprehensive calendar of classical events in Richmond, around Virginia and in the Washington area, posted on the first of each month. Clarke Bustard is a music critic, cultural writer and broadcaster in Richmond, VA. The former classical music writer for the Richmond Times-Dispatch, Bustard is a recipient of the ASCAP Deems Taylor Award and other awards from state and national press associations.

feeds.title: RVA Magazine » Music
feeds.description: RVA Magazine reports on regional music, art, and style with a focus on city nightlife, community activism, LGBTQ topics, DIY street culture, and graphic art. Know more about the latest music updates and the most recent news about your favorite singers and musicians.

feeds.title: DJ Dave's Musical Musings
feeds.description: DJ Dave's Musical Musings is a blog about broadcasting, music, music countdowns, pop music, radio, and retro rock. Visit the blog to read the articles about music. You can also find information on music from various decades, as well as your favorite genres.

feeds.title: Northern Virginia Music Teachers Association Blog
feeds.description: The Northern Virginia Music Teachers Association (NVMTA) is a warm and welcoming organization of more than 400 teachers of brass, keyboard, strings, voice, and woodwinds. It offers opportunities for professional development for teachers, as well as events, both competitive and noncompetitive, for their students. Check out the blog to stay updated about their activities and events.

feeds.title: Virginia is for Lovers Blog » Music
feeds.description: Learn about the music culture in Virginia with the Music section in the Virginia is for Lovers Blog. Read more about VTC's home for the Commonwealth's tourism industry. This site contains a wealth of information and assistance for the full spectrum of Virginia's travel businesses.

feeds.title: Frequency Music Group Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Virginia's Music Renaissance. They are promoting, connecting, and developing every passionate artist. Frequency Music Group was birthed organically in the Virginia Beach area in Jan 2018. Its Founder, Scott Medina, a talented and multi-faceted music producer and singer/songwriter hailing from San Diego California, saw the desperate need for a platform that would change the way the East Coast saw and portrayed their musical & creative talents by unifying the area and making quality services affordable.

feeds.title: The Uncommon Wealth » Music and Dance
feeds.description: Library of Virginia inspires learning, ignites imagination, creates possibilities, encourages understanding, and engages Virginia's past to empower its future. Read the articles about Music And Dance and learn more about the music and entertainment from the past. Get to know about some of the best Virginia-born artists.

feeds.title: The Birthplace of Country Music Blog
feeds.description: The Birthplace of Country Music is a nonprofit organization that seeks to perpetuate, promote, and celebrate Bristol's rich musical heritage; to educate and engage audiences worldwide, to create recognition, opportunities, and economic benefit for the local and regional communities. Stay updated with their latest posts on the blog.
